title: A gradebook report with collectors
description:
Produce a full report of students' marks with one `collect` per question.

```
class average 71.4
by grade: A=3, B=5, C=4, D=2, F=1
best in each subject: maths Ada 98, art Cy 91, history Bob 88
passed: 14, failed: 1 (Dee)
min..max: 38..98
```
hints: "Best in each subject" is `groupingBy(Mark::subject, TreeMap::new, maxBy(comparingInt(Mark::score)))` (lesson 8.03).
Grades come from a small method that turns a score into a letter, used as the grouping key.
requirements: A record `Mark(String student, String subject, int score)`.
Use `groupingBy` with downstream collectors, `partitioningBy`, `teeing` and `toMap` with a merge function.
stretch: Write your own `Collector` that gives the median of a group.
